gate_interpretation: No merge-interference (RG) measurement exists for any non-Llama architecture in this codebase (results/merging/ has Llama-3.2-1B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 only), and the planned dump wave fills raw-K banks only — so the prereg's literal D(L)=z[M]-z[C] (s1.1) cannot be built for arch-2 under any currently described data collection. This is a property of the experiment design, not a missing file. Arch-2 replication is instead tested against a SINGLE-SIDED PROXY target T_arch2(L) = z_grid[|C_arch2(L)|] — arch-2's own within-probe collateral-dominance MAGNITUDE — not a merge-vs-collateral dissociation. A PASS against this proxy is WEAKER than the prereg's literal wording and must be reported as such (see arch2.target.target_kind).

abs() on C_arch2 is load-bearing, not cosmetic: Qwen-1.5B's within-probe rho is sign-inverted at measured depths (rho_C<0; memory crossarch-transfer-verdict-2026-07-02) while Llama-1B's is positive throughout its grid. Tracking the raw signed rho would conflate depth-SHAPE with an incidental global sign flip. For arch-1 this is a strict no-op (its C(L) is already all-positive on the prereg grid), so build_dissociation() / tracking_test() run UNMODIFIED and arch-1 numbers are byte-identical to depth_dissoc_sketch.py's own descriptive run.

C_arch2(L) is (a) auto-discovered by running within_probe_rhos (imported from analyze_matrices.py, the G1 gate's own primitive) on any local results/matrices/gate_<tag>_rome_cf_L<L>_s*.npz found, point estimate only (no permutation null — out of scope for a depth-shape target), and/or (b) supplied via --arch2_collateral_json, which OVERRIDES the auto value per layer. Layers with neither are ABSENT from the profile, never treated as 0.

On the data situation named in the task brief (qwen15b raw-K planned at L14/L17/L21/L24; this repo's matrices npz exist only at L14 — L17/L21/L24 have mechanism_dump.py S-factor summaries only, which carry no COS/damage matrix), the DEFAULT on-box run with no --arch2_collateral_json is EXPECTED to return arch2.decidable=false. That is disclosed here, not hidden.

gate.literal_gate_decidable is ALWAYS false and gate.literal_gate_verdict is ALWAYS 'UNDECIDABLE_AS_PREREGISTERED' on every code path in this script — the prereg's LITERAL two-family replication gate can never be decided here (bullet 1). gate.verdict is a SEPARATE, practical field: 'KILL_FOR_GATE_PURPOSES' means one or both arches are undecidable on current data (more data could still change the picture); 'KILL' means both arches were fully measured and no statistic replicated on both against the proxy target; 'PASS_PROXY_TARGET' means a statistic DID replicate against the proxy target. Bare 'PASS' is never emitted — a hostile reviewer (or anything parsing this JSON) must not be able to mistake a proxy-target match for the pre-registered gate firing.
